reference_observations.description: Revisit with the April 3 Darwin reply and Hooker forwarding context in the 1858–1859 period. Do not infer the unavailable full list or cover.
The three-page appeal circular is missing. The £480 mark is probably Darwin’s annotation; a later June circular is not automatically this enclosure.
Preserve all 25 blocks and burnt versus natural sample columns, including totals 99.69 and 100.13. The source is more than its catalogue summary.
Preserve the 26-block incomplete German argument and separate Darwin notes; behavior, parasites and ornament hypotheses are not interchangeable observed facts.

relationship_details.response_date_policy: May13 explicit, year1845 editorial; retain basis, do notinfer physicalarrival.
relationship_details.rationale: Additional average-size, abundance andpreservation data requested866 are precisely thedata Darwin says he cannot supply. Expeditionnews belongs toanothermissing input.

corrections.description: The editorial summary says 1848 Manual, but the underlying list concerns the 1856 second edition. P1 is editorial synopsis; P2–3 are Gray text. The 146-species list is not transcribed. The April 3 reply is a receipt witness distinct from an April annotation; missing cover was forwarded to Hooker.
Darwin says no drunkard is known to him, a qualified personal report. Do not convert it into a categorical population measure or proven causal effect of mission work.

Agnes Haeckel gives an explicitly approximate German account of a missing Darwin letter. This is not verbatim Charles prose or a full original fragment; preserve the distinction between earlier letter arrival and hearing the German rendering today.
The 54-signatory memorial is collective institutional advocacy with eleven reasons, not an individually authored Charles letter. Retain January 14 XML versus before-January-16 display bounds.
Günther’s nine numbered answers retain specimen and preservation biases. He says females are usually larger; do not replace this with Darwin’s later male-larger account.
The Gryphaea locality is Verdachellum, not Pondicherry. Preserve the actual stratigraphic drawing and the missing Darwin inquiry; no exact day follows from the open upper bound.

summary: Eleven targets and seven contexts reuse matched accepted primary full-source readings. No new current-period relationship. Gray 2249 is an 1858 lead; Forbes 809 retains its unresolved after-February-1845 date. Earlier Forbes direct and forwarded-knowledge relationships remain accepted without recounting. Complete tables, German prose and annotations, institutional memorial, translated paraphrase and actual stratigraphic/map figures remain in their source-specific scopes.
